comment: Decisions resolved at the gate, not a quality rejection - the review passed. All twelve registry entries are RESOLVED at v6, the clarification report is at v6, and three conventions were amended: SC-5 (10kb body limit), SC-9 (audit event carries event/userId/requestId only, best-effort after commit), AD-6 (taxonomy extended with UnsupportedMediaTypeError and PayloadTooLargeError, mapping gains 413, US-001 named as the Story that creates errors.ts with four subclasses). Re-run SPECIFICATION to consume them.

FR-18 confirmed: the four JWT variables are removed from .env.example. Nothing this Story ships reads them, and SC-3 keeps them out of src/config/env.ts until the Story that validates each - US-002 re-adds them together with the code that reads them. This was flagged at the gate twice and is now decided rather than read as tacit consent. The four Minor findings of review v11 are accepted as design inputs for API_DESIGN and IMPLEMENTATION_PLANNING, not as blockers: m-1 (no component row owns the translation of express.json() errors into PayloadTooLargeError and ValidationError, while the 415's owner is named) is the one with real downstream weight.

findings.summary: IMPLEMENTATION owes it: .env.example lines 16-20 still declare JWT_ACCESS_SECRET, JWT_REFRESH_SECRET, JWT_ACCESS_TTL and JWT_REFRESH_TTL, which FR-18 requires this Story to remove
Specification v14 names four DomainError subclasses at four sites where architecture.md AD-6 names five; AD-6 is canonical and the Specification is the stale copy
a root prisma.config.ts fails npm run lint unless tsconfig.typecheck.json include gains it, and its DATABASE_URL read must be reconciled with AD-7
.env.test is git-ignored by .gitignore:28, so the PC-1 test setup cannot be committed and CI would have no test DATABASE_URL
TEST_WRITING owes it: Zod leaves details.fieldErrors empty for both the unknown-property and the non-object-body 400, and minProperties must reach the generated document
the request-id middleware must mount ahead of the rate limiter or the 429 cannot carry its required X-Request-Id
express-rate-limit emits RateLimit-* and Retry-After headers the approved contract declares nowhere
PR_PREPARATION owes it: the PR summary should cite the 2026-09-01 authorization and PC-1 so the breadth does not read as scope creep
TEST_WRITING owes it: three request shapes reach one 400 through two Zod paths; cover all three, not only the bodyless POST with a content type
IMPLEMENTATION_VERIFICATION owes it: email declared format and bounds describe the normalized value, so compare the generated contract semantically
human decision owes it: persistence-conventions.md PC-1 predates Prisma 7 and describes neither the adapter object nor the separate migration config file
the revision-14 preamble miscounts its own changes; a defect in an artifact past its human gate with no proportionate route back
FR-5 places an obligation on US-003 that nothing in this Story can satisfy or test; same reason
specification v14 and review v11 came from one session turn under different Skills, so the PASS is not an independent second opinion; the gate is not reopened
no SPEC_REVIEW to SPECIFICATION event was appended for review v8; history.jsonl is append-only
attempts 3 and 4 carry hardcoded timestamps ahead of the real clock; same reason
the DESIGN_REVIEW to IMPACT_ANALYSIS event carries attempt 2 where the to_stage rule gives 1; same reason
the normalization CHECK is deliberately unspecified - Prisma cannot express one while PC-2 makes schema.prisma the source of truth; endorsed twice
declining changes_required_specification for e-1 is accepted; the residual risk is e-1 itself, which stays open
minLength 1 on email is redundant beside format email; noted so no later reader takes it for a rule

TEST_WRITING precedes IMPLEMENTATION but the schema, migration and compose file arrive in plan steps 2-3, so the tests authored at TEST_WRITING cannot execute until then and must not be gated on a running suite

plan D-2 uses the env() helper prisma/config exports so prisma.config.ts reads no process.env and AD-7 needs no amendment, verified by importing it on the installed prisma 7.10.0; D-3 adds the file to tsconfig.typecheck.json include in step 1

plan D-4 picks the !.env.test negation with CI on port 5433 and an external DATABASE_URL override; git check-ignore confirms the .gitignore:28 block the resolution removes. PLAN_REVIEW:p-1 carries the uncited conventions to the gate
plan D-5 fixes the eleven-step src/app.ts assembly with requestId at position 5 and the rate limiter at 7, so the 429 carries the X-Request-Id its contract requires
plan D-6 sets standardHeaders and legacyHeaders false; the Retry-After write confirmed gated on those two flags at express-rate-limit 8.7.0 dist/index.cjs:1052, so no undeclared header survives

HUMAN_PLAN_APPROVAL owes it: plan D-4 commits .env.test but cites only the AGENTS.md Prohibited line, not persistence-conventions.md PC-10 or PC-1's own never-committed bullet, and does not list itself as an Open Question

IMPLEMENTATION_PLANNING owes it: plan line 707 writes AC-010 where it means api-conventions.md AC-10, which reads as a Story Acceptance Criterion that does not exist; lines 398 and 639 write AC-10 correctly

IMPLEMENTATION owes it: plan step 3 asks for fileParallelism false scoped to tests/integration without naming a mechanism, but fileParallelism is a top-level test option in vitest 4.1.11 and the current flat config covers both trees in one include; test.projects is the mechanism, confirmed by probe

human decision owes it: security-conventions.md SC-3 line 178 cites api-conventions.md AC-5 for the 429 error body, but AC-5 is Error status codes and AC-6 is Error body; SC-3 line 111 cites AC-6 correctly
IMPLEMENTATION_PLANNING owes it: the plan traceability row for AC-004 lists VR-5...VR-8 as delivered, but spec VR-7 defers the breached-password check to US-009 and runs nowhere in this Story

comment: Rejected on PLAN_REVIEW:p-3. Step 3 states an outcome the mechanism it names cannot produce: it asks for fileParallelism false scoped to tests/integration while unit tests stay parallel, but fileParallelism is a top-level test option and the current flat vitest config covers both trees in one include, so as written it would either serialize the whole suite or scope nothing. Revise IMPLEMENTATION_PLANNING to name a supported Vitest project/configuration mechanism (test.projects is the one PLAN_REVIEW confirmed by probe at vitest 4.1.11) that disables file parallelism for tests/integration only and preserves unit-test parallelism, and resubmit for HUMAN_PLAN_APPROVAL. p-3 is reassigned from IMPLEMENTATION to IMPLEMENTATION_PLANNING by this decision and stays RAISED until the revised plan names the mechanism. Not decided here and still owed at the next gate: PLAN_REVIEW:p-1 (D-4 commits .env.test citing neither PC-10 nor PC-1), DESIGN_REVIEW:e-1 (spec v14 stale against AD-6), PLAN_REVIEW:p-4 (SC-3 line 178 cites AC-5 for the error body) and the plan's two Open Questions. The other three review findings, p-2 and p-5 and the review's four required plan edits, may be folded into the same revision.

findings.summary: plan v2 D-10 names test.projects and writes out the two-project shape; a timestamped probe at vitest 4.1.11 showed unit files overlapping and integration files strictly serial, and globalSetup on the integration project running exactly once instead of three times at root
plan v2 Testing Strategy writes AC-10 (api-conventions.md); no AC-010 remains anywhere in the plan
plan v2 AC-004 traceability row reads VR-5, VR-6, VR-8 and marks VR-7 deferred to US-009

IMPLEMENTATION_PLANNING owes it: D-10's two projects include src/**/*.test.ts and tests/integration/**/*.test.ts, so tests/harness.test.ts is collected by neither and silently stops running with a green exit code

IMPLEMENTATION_PLANNING owes it: Step 3 requires the test DATABASE_URL to fall back to .env.test but names no reader for it; no dotenv is declared, vite's loadEnv is only transitive, and Node v24.20.0's process.loadEnvFile is the zero-dependency mechanism

plan v3 D-10 declares a third project 'harness' with include ['tests/*.test.ts']; npx vitest list with no --project filter collects tests/harness.test.ts, and a probe showed the v2 two-project shape exiting 0 with the file absent once an integration test exists

plan v3 Step 3 and D-10 name process.loadEnvFile() on the installed Node v24.20.0 as the .env.test reader, guarded on process.env.DATABASE_URL being unset so an external value wins, with the ENOENT case wrapped to name the command to run; no dependency added
